_why: Methods that read as the CRUD of a collection of configured things (planning#440 step 6, D1013). Each family is a contiguous block that its packet deletes with the methods; `permanent` matches by name but is a runtime read or another kind of thing. The list only shrinks.

notifiers.notification-output.cap.ts:listTargetKin: kind catalogue of notification targets; stays: the dispatcher's byte budgets (bodyMaxLen, maxActions), the rule editor's deliveryParams, the icons, the test panel and the viewer's nc.listTargetKinds read it (P6a left it; folding it into integration-instances kinds is a follow-up)
notifiers.notification-output.cap.ts:discoverTarge: form helper that scans for targets to offer in the create form; stays as a helper (D981), P6a decides
notifiers.notification-output.cap.ts:probeTargetCo: form helper that probes a draft target config; stays as a helper (D981), P6a decides

training.training-provider.cap.ts:describeTypes: type catalogue of training provider entries; kinds of integration-instances (P6g)
training.training-provider.cap.ts:listEntries: entry list; still read by the training orchestrator (api-ports addonForEntry), not by any page (P6g)

addon-settings.addon-settings.cap.ts:getIntegrationForm: form of the addon-level integration settings; retired with the addon-level settings (M5, D986, P8)

permanent.storage.cap.ts:listLocations: runtime read of the locations with occupancy and state, not the CRUD of the configured rows
permanent.storage.cap.ts:listLocationDeclarations: runtime read of the locations a node declares (describe()), feeds the instance kinds
permanent.storage.cap.ts:listDrainProgress: runtime read of the drain progress of a location, not configuration
permanent.backup.cap.ts:listLocations: size and file counts of the state subsections a backup can include, not configured locations
permanent.backup.cap.ts:getEntries: lists the entries of a backup archive, not configured things
permanent.board-key-source.cap.ts:listSources: lists the registered providers of board keys (a collection cap read), not configured instances
permanent.device-extension.cap.ts:listSources: per-device read of the slot owners (D554), not configured instances
permanent.device-manager.cap.ts:listLocations: the site locations (rooms) devices sit in, not an integration family
permanent.device-manager.cap.ts:addLocation: creates a site location (a room), not an integration instance
permanent.device-manager.cap.ts:removeLocation: removes a site location (a room), not an integration instance
permanent.record-entries.cap.ts:listEntryKinds: generic record browser over any record kind, not one instance family
permanent.record-entries.cap.ts:listEntries: generic record browser over any record kind, not one instance family
permanent.record-entries.cap.ts:deleteEntry: generic record browser over any record kind, not one instance family
permanent.recording.cap.ts:listSources: per-device read of the recordable sources of a camera, not configured instances
permanent.videoclips.cap.ts:listSources: per-device read of the clip sources of a camera, not configured instances
permanent.terminal-session.cap.ts:listProfiles: the pre-declared terminal profiles an operator may open, a fixed catalogue; terminal sessions have their own typed cap
